title: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLICIT DIRECTLY TO NORTH COAST ELECTRIC COMPANY
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION NORTHWESTERN.ENDIST PORTLAND.W071 ENDIST PORTLAND
detail_text: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLICIT DIRECTLY TO NORTH COAST ELECTRIC COMPANY (RFO FAR 6.103-1(b)) Solicitation Number: W9127N26Q1BAP Agency: Department of the Army Office: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Location: USACE District, Portland Classification Code: 5810 – Electronic & Communication Equipment NAICS Code: 334111 – Computer and Peripheral Equipment Manufacturing Notice Type: Notice of Intent to Solicit Directly from Supplier IAW. RFO FAR 12.201-1(c)(2)(i). This is a pre-solicitation notice, IAW RFO FAR 5.1. Synopsis: This is a special notice prepared in accordance with the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 5.1 “Pre-solicitation Notice.” The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Portland District intends to solicit this directly to North Coast Electric Company as a firm-fixed-price supply contract to procure National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) Allen Bradley Programable Logic Controller (PLC) Equipment. The statutory authority for this is 10 U.S.C 3204(a)(1) or 41 U.S.C 3304(a)(1) and RFO FAR 6.103-1(b). A SOLICITATION WILL NOT BE POSTED The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Portland District intends to solicit this directly to North Coast Electric Company as a firm-fixed-price supply contract to procure Allen Bradley Programmed Logic Controller (PLC) Supplies for the Willamette Valley Project. The NAICS Code: 334111 – Computer and Peripheral Equipment Manufacturing. THIS NOTICE IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS OR QUOTATIONS Interested concerns must show clear and convincing evidence that competition of this requirement would be advantageous to the Government by submitting a capability statement that they have ability to supply the required supplies meeting the government’s need. If no affirmative written responses are received by 11:00 AM PST on 18 MARCH 2026 , the solicitation will be made directly to suppliers. Oral communications are not acceptable in response to this notice. A determination by the Government not to solicit this action on the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) is solely within the discretion of the Government, IAW RFO FAR 6.103-1(b). Electronic responses and questions shall be submitted via email to the contracting point of contact listed below. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers is not responsible for any costs incurred by responding to this notice. Contracting Office Point of Contact: Raymie Briddell, Raymie.L.Briddell@usace.army.mil
